questions.question: After hearing that King Hezekiah had recovered from his illness, the king of Babylon sent him what?
King Hezekiah showed the envoys from Babylon only a few of his treasures. True or false?
The prophet Isaiah told King Hezekiah what would one day happen to everything in his palace?

answers.text: It would be carried off to Babylon
It would be burned in a great fire
It would be taken away by Assyria

questions.question: When the prophet Isaiah told King Hezekiah the LORD's message about his treasures being taken away, what did Hezekiah say about it?

answers.text: That it could not be true
